Brazil, India are building strategic ties for a changing world, says Brazil’s Foreign Minister

en.title: Trump administration may raise tariffs on many countries including India and China
en.dek: Report says Trump administration may raise tariffs on many countries including India and China
facts: A report indicates the Trump administration is considering raising tariffs on multiple countries including India and China
Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira was in New Delhi
Vieira addressed the BRICS Business Forum Leaders' Session
The Hindu published an interview with Vieira
S2 contains a photo caption and community guidelines notice
body: A report from Times of India indicates the Trump administration is considering raising tariffs on multiple countries including India and China, though the report did not specify timeline or exact rates.
Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira was in New Delhi to address the BRICS Business Forum Leaders' Session, as noted in The Hindu.
The Hindu's reporting includes a photo caption identifying Vieira addressing the forum and a community notice about platform migration.
Vieira praised India's BRICS presidency during the forum session, according to The Hindu's account of the interview.
en.context: The Times of India reported that the Trump administration is considering raising tariffs on multiple countries. The Hindu reported that Brazilian Foreign Minister Mauro Vieira was in New Delhi and addressed the BRICS Business Forum Leaders' Session.

de.title: Trump-Regierung könnte Zölle auf viele Länder erhöhen, darunter Indien und China
de.dek: Bericht: Trump-Regierung könnte Zölle auf viele Länder erhöhen, darunter Indien und China
facts: Bericht deutet an, dass die Trump-Regierung höhere Zölle für mehrere Länder einschließlich Indien und China in Erwägung zieht
Brasilianischer Außenminister Mauro Vieira war in Neu-Delhi
Vieira sprach auf der BRICS-Geschäftsforum-Sitzung der Führungskräfte
The Hindu veröffentlichte ein Interview mit Vieira
S2 enthält einen Bildunterschrift- und Community-Richtlinien-Hinweis
body: Eine Meldung der Times of India zufolge erwägt die Trump-Regierung, Zölle auf mehrere Länder, darunter Indien und China, zu erhöhen. Das Bericht gab jedoch keine zeitliche Angabe oder konkreten Sätze an.
Der brasilianische Außenminister Mauro Vieira war nach Angaben der Hindu in Neu-Delhi, um den BRICS-Geschäftsforum-Gipfel der Führungskräfte zu adressieren.
Die Berichterstattung der Hindu enthält ein Foto, das Vieira bei der Rede zeigt, sowie eine Gemeinschaftsmitteilung über einen Plattformwechsel.
Vieira lobte laut Hindu-Bericht Indiens BRICS-Vorsitz während des Forum-Termins.
de.context: Die "Times of India" berichtete, dass die Trump-Regierung höhere Zölle für mehrere Länder in Erwägung zieht. Die "The Hindu" berichtete, dass brasilianischer Außenminister Mauro Vieira in Neu-Delhi war und die BRICS-Geschäftsforum-Sitzung der Führungskräfte adressierte. @@CAPTION||

ko.title: 트럼프 행정부, 인도·중국 등 다수 국가에 대한 관세 인상 검토
ko.dek: 보고서에 따르면 트럼프 행정부가 인도·중국 등 다수 국가에 대한 관세 인상을 검토 중
facts: 보고서에 따르면 트럼프 행정부가 인도·중국 등 다수 국가에 대한 관세 인상을 검토 중
브라질 외교장관 마우루 비에이라가 뉴델리에 도착
비에이라가 BRICS 비즈니스 포럼 리더 세션에 참석
S2에 사진 캡션 및 커뮤니티 가이드라인 안내 포함
body: 트럼프 행정부가 인도를 비롯한 여러 국가에 대해 관세 인상을 검토하고 있다고 인도 타임스 오브 인디아지가 보도했습니다. 다만 구체적인 시점이나 세율은 명시되지 않았습니다.
브라질 외교장관 마우루 비에이라가 힌두(The Hindu)에 따르면 BRICS 비즈니스 포럼 리더 세션 참석을 위해 뉴델리를 방문했습니다.
힌두는 비에이라가 포럼에서 연설하는 사진과 플랫폼 이전 커뮤니티 공지 등을 포함하고 있습니다.
비에라는 힌두지의 인터뷰 보도에 따르면 BRICS 의장국인 인도를 칭찬했습니다.
ko.context: 《더 타임스 오브 인디아》 보도에 따르면 트럼프 행정부가 다수 국가에 대한 관세 인상을 검토 중인 것으로 알려짐. 《더 힌두》 보도에 따르면 브라질 외교장관 마우루 비에이라가 뉴델리에 방문해 BRICS 비즈니스 포럼 리더 세션에 참석함. @@CAPTION||

problemsFixed: Facts 4 and 5 are not in the provided sources (S1, S2). The draft introduces claims about Brazil-India trade targets, BRICS presidency praise, and BRICS being non-anti-Western from S2, but S2 only contains a paywall notice and a photo caption. S1 only contains a Mutual Fund Calculator mention. No source supports the tariff claim beyond the headline text, and no source supports the Brazil-India claims.
Dek uses 'report says' without attributing to a specific outlet in the sources.
Body contains unsupported claims about Brazil-India trade ($30 billion target, 2030 deadline) and BRICS stance.
Four short declarative sentences in a row in paragraph 1 of body.
Repetitive opening of sentences with 'The Trump administration' and 'Vieira'.
Context contains unsupported claims about Trump administration tariff plans and Brazil-India strategic ties.
